problem.title: Cyclotron period of an electron (JEE Main type)
problem.text:
An electron moves at 1.0e6 m/s perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field of
0.010 T. What is the period of its circular motion -- and why does the answer not
depend on the speed?
problem.source: Cyclotron problem type (JEE Main magnetism style; cf. OpenStax University Physics 2, 11.3, CC BY); statement rewritten and values chosen for this corpus, not reproduced.

because.detail: An electron, with charge and mass fixed by nature rather than by the problem.

because.law_label: Circular motion in a uniform magnetic field
because.law_statement: A charge moving perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field travels a circle whose radius is mv/(qB) and whose period is independent of speed.
